dinner.description: Spicy chicken fried rice – local favorite (adjust spice level for child)

Fine‑dining set menu featuring Darjeeling tea‑infused sauces – premium setting

days.notes: The zoo has gentle slopes; keep child’s shoes secure. Take short breaks between exhibits.

days.notes: Watch for occasional drizzle; the estate walk includes gentle inclines – pause often for the child.

warnings: Altitude (~2,050 m) may cause mild sickness; allow 24 h of light activity before strenuous outings.
November forecast shows light to moderate rain – pack rain gear and waterproof footwear.
Toy‑train tickets sold by unofficial agents near Mall Road are often overpriced; purchase at Darjeeling Railway Station counter or via IRCTC.
Taxi/jeep fares are negotiable – confirm rates (shared jeep ~₹15‑30 per seat, private day‑cab ₹1,500‑2,500).
Tiger Hill railings have gaps; hold the child’s hand at all times.
Uneven hillside terrain at Happy Valley Tea Estate and the zoo can be challenging for a 10‑year‑old; wear sturdy shoes and take frequent breaks.
Toy train joyride ticket scam: agents near Mall Road claim sold out and charge ₹2,000–3,000; buy directly at Darjeeling railway station counter or via IRCTC to avoid overpayment.

Taxi/jeep pricing is negotiated; confirm rates before hiring to avoid inflation: shared jeep within town ₹15–30/seat, full-day sightseeing cab ₹1,500–2,500; NJP→Darjeeling shared jeep ₹250–300/person, private cab ₹2,000–2,500.
Altitude 2,050m may cause mild altitude sickness; allow 24 hours of light activity before strenuous outings, especially for those arriving from the plains.
Vegetarian meals must be explicitly requested as default dishes are non‑vegetarian; verify ingredients when ordering.
Limited toddler‑specific food options at outer sites (Happy Valley, Rock Garden); carry snacks from Darjeeling town for the child.
Current forecast shows light to moderate rain with high likelihood; pack rain gear and waterproof footwear.
Tiger Hill viewpoint has no barriers at the railing; hold the child’s hand at all times for safety.
Roads can be blocked by landslides July–September; while November is generally clear, check road status before travel.
